original_page_visual_review.scope: Entire actual Chinese page: prose and proof, every inline/display expression, nested continued fractions, partial quotient sequences, operator bounds, algorithm steps, footnote and exercise symbols where present.

bilingual_review.scope: Actual corresponding English source images inspected, every matching formula, prime, subscript, bound, sequence entry, prose/proof passage and footnote compared; not inferred from pagination offset or OCR agreement.
bilingual_review.qualification: Original general proofs transcribed; separately described finite and numerical computations do not replace those proofs.

rendered_proof.inline_katex_nowrap: Current book-markdown renderer and actual KaTeX stylesheet; each inline math expression remains unbroken and locally scrollable.
rendered_proof.qualification: Standalone eight-page proof, not full-volume/final site acceptance.
